messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled 15:00 UTC for service `inference-api` has been PAUSED by incident gateway-502. Canary 1/4 ok, canary 2 failed. Pinning prod -> v2.3.4 and stopping further rollout :warning:
Alex: Copy. Do we want an immediate rollback to v2.3.3 or freeze and wait for incident ETA?
Maya: Incident summary from ops: gateway 502 in EU, upstream proxy flapping. Mitigation in progress, ETA 30-40m. My recommendation: freeze for now, avoid forward rollouts. DB migration? none in this patch.
Chris: Release was feature-flag + config tweaks only, rollback should be safe. We can rollback to v2.3.3 if ops wants to reduce blast radius.
Alex: If rollback, who triggers? Need approval from oncall + release lead. @ops-oncall can you confirm ETA and preference?
Ops Oncall: ETA still ~30-40m. Prefer freeze unless customer impact increases; currently a subset of EU traffic only. If we roll back, expect ~6m of deploy time and short cache warm-up.
Maya: Freeze sounds good. If status doesn't improve in 25m, we'll rollback. Please prepare rollback steps and release notes update.
Chris: Preparing rollback command/snippet and smoke checklist now.
Chris: ```
# rollback command
deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v2.3.3 --strategy immediate
# smoke checks
curl -sS https://eu.api.example.com/health | jq .status
# check canary logs: gcloud logging read "resource.labels.service=inference-api AND severity>=WARNING" --limit 50
```
Alex: Thanks. @deploy-bot hold any automated requeues until we have an explicit go.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-requeue disabled for thread 1747654321.
Chris: Running smoke locally first, will report in 10m.
Maya: I'll update the release notes with a pinned note: "Rollout paused due to EU gateway 502; pinned at v2.3.4" and add rollback plan placeholder.
Alex: If ops calls for rollback, Chris will execute and Maya will coordinate comms. :thumbsup:
Ops Oncall: If we rollback, we'll also re-run small load test in EU after rollback to validate gateway behavior.
Chris: Smoke passed locally. Standing by to run rollback if no improvement by +25m.
Maya: Logging action item: schedule requeue slot tomorrow 09:00 UTC if we abort rollback.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll update the release board and mark this release as gated until cleared.
